name: microscope-batch-color-studio
description: High-Quality Local Batch Microscope Image Color Processing Web Application

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n API,WEB -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.setup:backend: python -m venv backend\.venv && backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r backend\requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm install
